artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan to rename 71 public and 103 private snake_case defs to lowerCamelCase, delete the DenseObstructionTransfer nolint attribute, update all citations, and correct NAMING_CONVENTION_DEVIATION.md.

memory_candidates.content: A linter that observes a package by IMPORTING it (Lean's Batteries env_linter family, invoked via `lake exe runLinter <Root>`) has four structural blind spots, and a green run is evidence about the instrument, not about the tree: (1) modules outside the root's import closure are never elaborated, so their findings do not exist; (2) upstream name heuristics silently exempt shapes -- Mathlib's isBadNameWithUnderscore skips any name whose last component ends in `_1`, `_2` or `_mathlib` as presumed autogenerated; (3) an in-source `attribute [nolint X]` produces NO finding at all, so it is invisible to the linter, to CI, and to a nolints.json baseline diff alike -- strictly less reviewable than a JSON entry, which at least shows as a line in a file; (4) `private` declarations are not exported to an importing module, so no env_linter can ever see one -- measured in this repo as ZERO non-auto private declarations in the environment of `import FormalSystem` against 103 `private def` snake_case names in the tree. Consequence for planning: when a task's acceptance bar is 'the linter reports 0', pair it with an independent repo-local TEXTUAL scan; when the two disagree, the textual scan is the ground truth and the gap is the defect.
